objective: Bring the Crate of Powerstones to Quartermaster Lungertz, before the powerstones expire.

description: This crate of powerstones needs to go to Nethergarde Keep, in the Blasted Lands.  They won't hold their power for long, so we can't ship them with the next caravan.
You must take them, and you must take them quickly.
Bring them to Quartermaster Lungertz in Nethergarde Keep.  To reach the keep, you must travel east through Deadwind Pass, then east through the Swamp of Sorrows, then south through the Blasted Lands.
Use caution, <name>.  You will travel through dangerous lands, yet you must not fail.
progress: Hello! Don't mind all the commotion, it's just business as usual at Nethergarde Keep.
completion: Ah, the powerstones! The mages will be happy to see these!
Many thanks, <name>. I know your trip from Darkshire was not an easy one.
